user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search results and search features
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for ChatGPT search answers; sites opted out won't appear in search results
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: OAI-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; takes ~24 hours to adjust

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; data not used for training generative AI models

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training generative AI foundation models to make them more useful and safe
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for training AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to exclude from AI training

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs when users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-initiated fetches; may visit web pages via GPT Actions; not automatic crawling
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply as actions are user-initiated; not used for Search determination

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content for training AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for model development and safety enhancement
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; also supports Crawl-delay directive

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to Claude user queries
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web content retrieval when individuals ask questions to Claude
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent content retrieval

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to improve search result quality
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for search indexing and optimization of search result relevance and accuracy
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent content indexing

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google Search indexes
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Google Search, Discover, Images, Video, News

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google Images and Search features
user_agents.scope: Image-specific crawling for Google Images, Discover, Video, favicons

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video-specific crawling for video Search features and products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News product
user_agents.scope: News-specific crawling for Google News and news.google.com

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl product information for Google Shopping
user_agents.scope: Shopping-specific crawling for Google Shopping and Shopping tab

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Testing and inspection for Search Console features
user_agents.scope: On-demand crawling for Rich Result Test and URL inspection tools

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various Google product teams
user_agents.scope: Generic crawling for internal R&D and product-specific research

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling for various Google product teams
user_agents.scope: Generic image-specific crawling for R&D purposes

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video crawling for various Google product teams
user_agents.scope: Generic video-specific crawling for R&D purposes

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.scope: Site-owner-requested crawling for Vertex AI Agent training

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for Gemini models and grounding
user_agents.scope: Controls whether crawled content used for Gemini model training and grounding

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result crawling for Perplexity search engine; does not crawl for AI training
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow PerplexityBot in robots.txt file; use User-Agent: PerplexityBot / Disallow: /

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions and fetch pages to provide accurate answers to user questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web page fetches; when users ask questions that require accessing live web content
user_agents.opt_out: Configure robots.txt rules (though Perplexity-User generally ignores robots.txt for user-requested fetches); use User-Agent: Perplexity-User / Disallow: /

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling to power search technology in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to index content for Apple search products and ecosystem features

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training Apple foundation models for generative AI features and Apple Intelligence
user_agents.scope: Secondary crawler that determines how Applebot-crawled data is used for AI model training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts only

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content shared on Meta family of apps to display title, description, thumbnail
user_agents.scope: Content from websites/apps shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: facebookexternalhit / Disallow: / in robots.txt (may bypass for security checks)

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality by analyzing online content for relevance and accuracy
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enhance Meta AI responses with citations and links

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for advertising optimization and business-related use cases

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Training foundation AI models and improving products by indexing content directly
user_agents.scope: General web content indexing for AI model training and product improvement

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities for website navigation
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for evaluating and improving AI navigation on websites
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: meta-externalfetcher / Disallow: / in robots.txt (may bypass for user-requested fetches)

user_agents.name: Copilot
user_agents.purpose: Microsoft's AI assistant for various tasks
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses and data collection
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow rules; user preferences in Microsoft account settings

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Bing search engine indexing and crawling
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search index updates
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt User-agent: Bingbot / Disallow: / or User-Agent: * / Disallow: /

user_agents.name: MicrosoftBot
user_agents.purpose: Microsoft general web crawler for indexing
user_agents.scope: General web crawl and content discovery

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services, train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product improvement and AI model training

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products like Alexa and Rufus
user_agents.scope: Crawl for search indexing; does not train generative AI models

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered actions like live web fetches for Alexa queries
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for live information to answer customer questions

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for creating a public internet archive and dataset
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, crawls publicly linked pages following robots.txt rules
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file blocks crawling

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Legacy web crawler for creating internet archive dataset
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for older Common Crawl archives
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file blocks crawling

user_agents.name: AI Training Crawlers (Generic)
user_agents.purpose: Content collection for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: Redirects for AI Training feature allows publishers to enforce canonical content and redirect verified crawlers to preferred pages

user_agents.name: AI Agents / Agentic Crawlers
user_agents.purpose: Autonomous agent interactions and live responses for AI-driven tasks
user_agents.scope: Real-time agent-triggered content fetches and interactions; accounted for under 10% of Cloudflare network traffic as of March 2026
user_agents.opt_out: HTTP 402 Payment Required (Pay-Per-Crawl) feature in beta; allows content owners to monetize or restrict access to automated crawlers
